Marker_Beacon.channels: crossed quads: U across, V bottom (0) to top (1). R core column, G halo, B rising bands (tiles in V; sample B a second time with V scrolled)

Marker_Emblem.channels: emblem mesh (planar UVs from the front): R centre-bright facet ramp, G rim; opaque emissive
